name: resonance
description: Review-gated Orchestrator and Executor coordination for large changes.

interface.shortDescription: Coordinate two agent roles through a control baton.
interface.longDescription: Resonance packages slash commands and workflow instructions for a review-gated two-agent workflow: one agent/session orchestrates, another executes, and both coordinate through control.md.
defaultPrompt: Start a resonance run for this change.
Review this large refactor with resonance.
Run the resonance executor for this UUID.
